latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Subtitle Generator Hinglish (v1.0.0).
- Enables generation of Hinglish subtitles for Hindi-English mixed videos up to 500MB.
- Supports popular video formats (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and exports finished videos in 1080p MP4.
- Simple onboarding: auto-detects or fetches cloud API token (NEMO_TOKEN) and sets up a secure session.
- Handles uploads, credits, status, and export workflows with guided prompts and cloud processing.
- Robust error handling for token, file type, credit, and rate limitation issues.
